ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Shota Imanaga's strong start leads Cubs to 6-1 win
imanaga.blurb: Shota Imanaga tosses six dominant innings and Michael Busch slugs a home run to lead the Cubs to a 6-1 win over the Marlins

suzuki.title: Luis Lara comes up clutch in walk-off win
suzuki.blurb: Jackson Chourio hits a game-tying homer in the 9th followed by Luis Lara's walk-off single in the 10th in the Brewers' 4-3 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Okamoto, Soriano spark Blue Jays' 4-2 win
okamoto.blurb: Kazuma Okamoto hits his 30th homer of the season and José Soriano tosses seven strong innings in the Blue Jays' 4-2 win over the Athletics

murakami.title: Five-run inning lifts Pirates to 9-3 win
murakami.blurb: Pirates score five runs in the first inning and don't look back as they beat the White Sox 9-3

matsui.title: Padres use four-run 8th for comeback win over Nats
matsui.blurb: Manny Machado hits a game-tying single and Luis Campusano drives in the go-ahead run to lead the Padres over the Nationals, 5-4
